Formula: Method of Lagrange Multipliers
Exact Expression: \nabla f(\mathbf{x}) = \sum_{i=1}^m \lambda_i \nabla g_i(\mathbf{x})
Definitions: Strategy for finding local maxima and minima of a function subject to equality constraints where gradients must be collinear.
Derivation/Reference: Joseph-Louis Lagrange, Mecanique Analytique (1788)
Example: Maximize xy subject to x + y = 2 -> (y, x) = lambda(1, 1) -> x = y = 1, lambda = 1 -> max = 1
Domain: multivariable_calculus
Assumptions: f and g_i have continuous first partial derivatives; Constraint gradients are linearly independent
Common Errors: Omitting verification of constraint qualification
subject: Method of Lagrange Multipliers
